slug: 2026-01-27 SA's Telcos, Banks At War With Govt Over 6,500% ID Verification Fee Hike

facts.fact: WeeTracker says banks, mobile operators and insurers use the Online Verification System to check customers' identity against the National Population Register for anti-money-laundering compliance, at R10 per real-time check from 1 July 2025 (previously 15 cents).
The article names banks (TymeBank, Capitec), mobile networks (Vodacom, MTN) and insurers as users of the NPR verification check.
